name: Kizuki Yuina
source:
A bright, innocent girl with a dazzling smile, overflowing with energy.

With a cheerful personality that values fun times with friends above all else, she is adored by both her classmates and juniors, serving as a sun-like presence at the center of everyone's attention.

In an academy full of students who simply follow the paths laid out by their parents, she possesses a inner strength that allows her to prioritize her own desires and put herself on the line for the sake of her precious friends.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1361154]Getchu[/url]]
